Amplifier: a) Equipment should have 32 or more channels which should include mo no- polar (AC/DC), Bipolar: (AC/DC), Referential and Ground electrodes. b) Communication interface to acquisition PC should be through Ethernet with power over Ethernet network or equivalent for high-speed data tran sfer. c) Integrated Event push button. d) 16-bit A/D conversion or better e) Input impedance: 100 Mega Ohms or more. f) CMRR>100db or better. g) Noise/2uV or less. h) Storage sampling rate should be configurable up to 2000 Hz or higher for all channels. 2. Software features: a) Easy set up and saving of montage templates. b) Possibility to insert event marker during the online review. c) Facility to customize protocol/montages/display setting as per user pr eference. d) The facility offers simultaneous acquisition and review modes, aided b y the page back Tab, which can be displayed either horizontally or vertic ally. Facility to view horizontal and vertical window under Split Tab. e) Facility for Prune/Trim down EEG with video to specified events along with user defined time before or after. f) Facility of Data Export in American Standard Code for Information Inte

Video Camera (1 No.) a) System should have facility for high resolution 4 Mega Pixel camera o r higher through pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) camera with at least 5X digital zoo m or higher. The camera must have built in IR illumination and audio ch annel. b) Perfect synchronization between Video & EEG recording. c) Integrated camera control from EEG software/ex Joystik. d) Mounting accessories fro wall or ceilling as per our lab requirement if required. 4. Computer System : a) Latest Core i7 or better available processor b) 16 GB RAM or better c) 1TB or better d) Preloaded Microsoft genuine Windows 10 or 11 pro e) DVD writer either integrated to the CPU or external to be provided. f) Keyboard, optical mouse with standard accessories. g) 24” TFT Monitor
